title: 浜辺の歌 (Hamabe no Uta — Song of the Beach)
description: A melancholy, evocative art song from 1916 about walking along the beach lost in memories. In the morning, the sea breeze and waves bring back the past. In the evening, the returning waves, moonlight, and stars continue to evoke the same half-remembered feelings. The archaic, poetic Japanese vocabulary makes this an excellent N3 study piece, and the gentle, wistful melody is one of the most beloved in all Japanese song.
